content.comment_body: Hello, I'm unable to transfer any user program to my [product_name] device using [product_name] V[version_no]. I can successfully ping the device, but when I attempt to transfer a simple program, I receive a connection error. The operating system is Windows 7 Professional 64 bit. Any suggestions?

Could you provide additional information? What is the IP address and subnet mask of your PC? What is the IP address and subnet mask of the device? Are the PC and device directly connected, or is there a router or switch involved?
Both systems are on the same subnet (255.255.255.0), and both are connected to the same switch.
Hello, Are you referring to something similar to: [product_name] in a corporate network - Entries - Forum - Industry Support ...?
Please refer to the attached video. When you follow those steps, does your device appear in the list? Could you share a screenshot of that window?
Yes, my device is found when I use the method shown in the video. It also responds to ping. However, I am still unable to transfer the user program.

I tried again, and now I receive the error message: Some network environment changes are detected. Restart [product_name] to apply the changes. I restarted everything, but the same message continues to appear.
The issue may be due to your LAN adapter name containing special characters, which causes problems for the [product_name] software.
I'm facing the same problem and am unsure how to rename the network card.
I'm not certain. It might only be possible by editing the Windows registry file.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have trouble transferring user programs to the [product_name] device with [product_name] V[version_no], even though network communication and device detection work as expected. The problem persists after trying several troubleshooting steps, and is linked to how the [product_name] software handles network adapter names with special characters. The error message about network changes does not provide clear guidance, causing confusion and frustration among users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want reliable connectivity and easy program transfers between [product_name] V[version_no] and the hardware device when the network is properly set up. They also expect straightforward, informative error messages and compatibility with typical network configurations.
